TUNING (WildChat window 1, current 2D cost model).

Rerun of the paper's WildChat appendix workload on the v3 2D cost model (the May 5 original ran the pre-2D model whose RTT term entered raw in seconds and was numerically invisible). Three arms, each on its own 3x L40S:2 fleet in the paper regions, sharing the same window and network conditions: gorgo-2d with online ES, plus random and simple-session-affinity as live controls (cross-run comparison to the May numbers is confounded by per-arm fleet RTT geometry).

Client: c=64 open-loop at time_scale 1.0 (11.4 rps synthetic arrivals) -- the May run used c=32, which backlogged ~21 min at the median and degenerated into closed-loop c=32; c=64 honors the schedule and matches the paper's main-experiment client settings.

Seeds: on WildChat the uncached term (~800 tokens, near-identical across replicas) cancels in the argmin, so routing is set by rtt_weight/queue_weight = queued tokens per ms of RTT. H100 prefills at ~0.04 ms/token (158 ms for a 4k-token warmup measured in the hetero session), so 1 ms RTT ~ 25 tokens; seed at rtt_weight=1.2, queue_weight=0.06 (ratio 20, both interior to the box; physical ~25 is inside the box's max ratio of 40). Ranges are the paper's box unchanged.

Fleet: v1 targeted the paper's L40S regions but ap-seoul-1/us-ashburn-1 never scheduled (L40S capacity); v2 switches to H100:1 in us-west4 / CANADA-2 / sines-2 (US / Canada / EU -- no Asia H100 capacity exists at relaunch time).
